name: Incontro Gin&Cocktailbar
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Incontro Gin & Cocktailbar in Serfaus**

Discover a cozy hideaway in the heart of the Alps, where expert mixologists craft bespoke cocktails and premium gin selections. Whether you're unwinding after a day on the slopes or seeking a sophisticated evening out, our intimate bar offers a warm atmosphere and creative drinks to elevate your stay in **Serfaus**.

Indulge in expertly tailored cocktails, from classic gin variations to innovative twists. Pair your experience with local specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn** or enjoy a moment of relaxation with a carefully curated selection of gins.

**Incontro**—where every sip tells a story of **Tirol’s** finest flavors and alpine charm.
